reason: My customers find me on Instagram, and my daughter already posts the specials there. I don't see who would look at a website, so 25 € every month is money I'd rather keep on a $22,000 income.
objection: Nobody looks at café websites any more, so I'd be paying every month for something nobody opens, plus another thing to learn.
would_change_my_mind: If the same message also updated my Instagram and Facebook, so I don't do the work twice, and I saw real customers in Sofia using the table QR menu.
